title: The Hospitality Standard
style: smooth professional pop, 108 BPM, hospitality industry theme, MOSOKO platform, male vocal warm and assured, hotel/service energy, multicultural competency, staff training vibe as anthem, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Japanese guest — you know the bow
Thai guest — wai — you know how
Arab guest — the right-hand rule
French guest — formal — that's the tool
It's not complicated
It's one lesson per culture
MOSOKO delivers it
In your voice — not a vulture

[CHORUS]
The hospitality standard
Is knowing before they arrive
The hospitality standard
Is keeping the culture alive
MOSOKO — the training
One voice — one lesson — one day
The hospitality standard
Is knowing what to say

[VERSE 2]
Hyatt, Claro, Namborus
Every venue — every fuss
MOSOKO codes in every pocket
Staff training — don't knock it
Your guest says your name right
You say their greeting back
That's the hospitality standard
And MOSOKO's the track

[OUTRO]
The standard. Starts with knowing. MOSOKO.
